card.name: Minimum threshold words before a number
card.fires_on: The last word of an "at least" or "greater than or equal to" phrase, or the ≥ sign, right before a numeric cutoff. Most often seen with lab counts or clearance values.

modes.label: Phrase ending before a number
modes.description: The word "least", "to" or "of" that completes a minimum-value phrase just before the number.

modes.label: Greater-or-equal symbol
modes.description: The ≥ sign placed before a lab threshold value.

modes.label: Spaced after At least
modes.description: The space after a sentence-opening "At least" before a count.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens meaning "at least" or "≥" (including Chinese ones), so it lowers the chance of repeating a minimum-value word where the number should come next.
card.plain: It fires on the wording that sets a minimum value, just before the number, such as "at least" or "greater than or equal to" in lab and kidney thresholds.
